body: Received the Best Artifact Award at ICSA 2026 for “Supporting Architecture-Level Resilience Analysis With an Integrated Chaos and Load Experimentation Framework.”
Our article “A Method for the Quality-Aware Automated Selection of Deployment Technologies” appeared in Software: Practice and Experience.
Five papers accepted for 2026 — at ICSA, ASE, MODELS, SIGCSE TS, and ICSE-SEET — spanning resilience analysis, model-driven optimisation, and gamified education.
Joined the Applied Education Technologies group at the Technical University of Munich as a postdoctoral researcher.
Completed my doctorate (Dr. rer. nat.), graded summa cum laude, at the University of Stuttgart on issue management and propagation analysis for component-based systems — read the dissertation ↗.
Elected steering-committee member of the GI Special Interest Group on Software Architecture and spokesperson of the Microservices & DevOps group.
Two papers on gamified and serious-game-based software engineering education presented at FSE 2025.
